extraction_metadata.notes: Reverse-engineered from arXiv:2610.35204 (Dorn et al., Oct 2026). 48-RNA REST2 replica-exchange MD catalog on HuggingFace.

title: mdRNAcat: A Molecular Dynamics RNA Catalog of REST2 Conformational Ensembles
subtitle_or_tagline: 48-RNA all-atom MD dataset for data-driven RNA modeling
topic: A curated dataset of all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of 48 RNA systems selected for sequence diversity. The dataset provides atomic coordinates, instantaneous forces, structural annotations, and metadata in HDF5 format. Forces are reevaluated under an unscaled reference Hamiltonian, enabling consistent training signals for data-driven RNA models including coarse-grained force fields.

components.name: REST2 Replica Exchange
components.role: Replica-exchange with solute scaling across 32 Hamiltonian states for enhanced sampling

components.name: All-atom MD engine
components.role: Production runs of 200-300 ns per Hamiltonian state

components.name: Reference-state reevaluation
components.role: Forces recomputed under unscaled Hamiltonian for consistent training signal

components.name: HDF5 catalog
components.role: Atomic coordinates + forces + annotations at 1 ps (reference) and 100 ps (all states)

architecture.data_flow: RNA sequence -> all-atom MD with REST2 -> reevaluate forces under reference Hamiltonian -> HDF5 catalog on HuggingFace

workflow_steps: Step 1 - Select 48 RNA systems for sequence diversity.
Step 2 - Run all-atom MD with REST2 (32 Hamiltonian states, 200-300 ns each).
Step 3 - Reevaluate forces under unscaled reference Hamiltonian.
Step 4 - Pack coordinates + forces + annotations into HDF5 at 1 ps / 100 ps cadence.
key_claims: First broad-purpose RNA MD catalog with consistent reference-Hamiltonian force reevaluation.
48 RNA systems selected for sequence diversity, not just functional class.
REST2 sampling captures conformational variability that single-trajectory MD misses.
Reusable resource for developing and evaluating data-driven RNA models including coarse-grained force fields.
caveats_or_warnings: REST2 enhances sampling of solute conformations but the reference state still needs careful re-weighting for unbiased observables.
48 systems is small relative to protein design catalogs; broad coverage is not yet possible.
RNA force-field accuracy (e.g. χ torsions, glycosidic preferences) remains an open issue beyond dataset size.
